description: This file defines an authentication service class for handling user authentication, registration, sign out, profile update, and persistence of authentication data using an API client and shared preferences.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class for handling authentication-related operations such as login, registration, sign out, profile update, and data persistence.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password using the API client, then persists token and user data.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, then persists authentication data.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user by removing stored token and user data.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user's profile information via API and updates stored user data.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user from shared preferences if available.
